apps/web/components/jovie/components/Cha.empty: The card renders one link from its platform and url props; it owns no collection that could be empty.
apps/web/components/jovie/components/Cha.offline: The card never fetches on render; a failed removal while offline surfaces through the same mutation error state shown by ErrorRemovalFails.

apps/web/components/jovie/components/Cha.empty: The card renders one merch action from its props; it owns no collection that could be empty.
apps/web/components/jovie/components/Cha.offline: The card never fetches on render; a failed confirm while offline surfaces through the same mutation error state shown by ErrorConfirmFails.
apps/web/components/jovie/components/Cha.loading: The confirming state lasts only between the confirm press and the server response, driven by the mutation, so a story cannot hold it on screen.

apps/web/components/jovie/components/Ent.loading: The pending state lasts one tick: useProjectedSourceFact awaits a dynamic import of a local module and no network request, so a story cannot hold it on screen.
apps/web/components/jovie/components/Ent.offline: The popover never fetches; it only reads props and a local dynamic import, so connectivity changes nothing it renders.

apps/web/components/jovie/components/Fee.loading: The pending state exists only between Submit and the server response, driven by the mutation, and cannot be held on screen by a story.
apps/web/components/jovie/components/Fee.offline: The form never fetches on render; an offline submit fails into the same error message shown by ErrorSubmitFails.

apps/web/components/marketing/artist-pro.empty: The section renders a fixed four-card earning loop from required copy; it owns no collection that could be empty.

apps/web/components/organisms/AvatarUplo.loading: The uploading label shows only while the avatar mutation is in flight, and a story has no prop or fast path that holds it on screen.
apps/web/components/organisms/AvatarUplo.offline: The form never fetches on render; an offline upload fails into the same alert shown by ErrorInvalidFileType.
apps/web/components/organisms/AvatarUplo.partial: The form renders one avatar and one button from required props; nothing loads in parts, and the no-photo variant is EmptyNoPhoto.
apps/web/components/organisms/AvatarUplo.permission-denied: The component reads no session or permission; the upload is available to whoever mounts it.

apps/web/components/organisms/billing/Gr.loading: The submitting state lasts only while the mutation is in flight, and a story has no prop that holds it; GrowthAccessRequestModal.test.tsx renders the pending state through the mutation mock.
apps/web/components/organisms/billing/Gr.error: The form has no error face: a failed request leaves the dialog open and re-enables Submit, so nothing distinct could be shown.
apps/web/components/organisms/billing/Gr.offline: The dialog never fetches on render; an offline submit is a failed request, which leaves the form open as described for error.
